mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `USER`) as totalUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `USER` WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') as activeUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `USER` WHERE created_at >= CURDATE()) as newUsersToday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUPPORT WHERE status = 'PENDING') as pendingFeedbacks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_ROLE ur JOIN ROLE r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE r.role_code IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN')) as adminCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MESSAGE WHERE emotion_id IS NOT NULL) as totalReports, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT chat_room_id) FROM CHAT_ROOM WHERE updated_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)) as activeConversations
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%H:00') as label, COUNT(*) as value FROM MESSAGE WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 8 HOUR) GROUP BY label ORDER BY label ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.slot, '%H:00') AS label, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id), 0) AS value FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), INTERVAL n HOUR) AS slot FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 ) nums ) h LEFT JOIN `USER` u ON u.last_login_at >= h.slot AND u.last_login_at < DATE_ADD(h.slot, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY h.slot ORDER BY h.slot ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(h.slot, '%H:00') AS label, COALESCE(COUNT(cr.chat_room_id), 0) AS value FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), INTERVAL n HOUR) AS slot FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 ) nums ) h LEFT JOIN CHAT_ROOM cr ON cr.created_at >= h.slot AND cr.created_at < DATE_ADD(h.slot, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) GROUP BY h.slot ORDER BY h.slot ASC
SELECT ec.emotion_name as label, COUNT(m.message_id) as value FROM MESSAGE m INNER JOIN EMOTION_CATEGORY ec ON m.emotion_id = ec.emotion_id GROUP BY ec.emotion_id, ec.emotion_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT c.name as label, COUNT(p.post_id) as value FROM POST p JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT u.user_id as userId, u.email, u.nickname, u.status, u.login_type as loginType, u.last_login_at as lastLoginAt, u.created_at as createdAt, r.role_code as roleName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOM cr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e2 ON cr.exclusive_id = e2.exclusive_id WHERE e2.user_id = u.user_id) as conversationCount, 0 as activityScore, COALESCE( (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(b.display_name), ''), b.name) FROM BOT b WHERE b.bot_id = u.assigned_bot_id), (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(b2.display_name), ''), b2.name) FROM EXCLUSIVE e INNER JOIN BOT b2 ON e.bot_id = b2.bot_id WHERE e.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY e.exclusive_id ASC LIMIT 1) ) as assignedBotName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUPPORT s INNER JOIN SUPPORT_REASON sr ON s.support_reason_id = sr.support_reason_id WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id AND sr.reason_type = 'REPORT') as reportCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUPPORT s WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id) as supportCount FROM `USER` u LEFT JOIN USER_ROLE ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN ROLE r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: -- DB 스키마의 ON DELETE CASCADE 설정으로 인해 USER 삭제 시 연관 데이터가 자동 삭제됩니다. DELETE FROM `USER` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId}

mapper.select: SELECT s.support_id as supportId, s.user_id as userId, u.nickname as userNickname, s.title, s.content, s.status, s.created_at as createdAt, sr.reason_name as reasonName, sr.reason_type as reasonType, sr.target_type as targetType, sa.content as answerContent, au.nickname as answerAdminNickname, sa.created_at as answerCreatedAt FROM SUPPORT s JOIN `USER` u ON s.user_id = u.user_id JOIN SUPPORT_REASON sr ON s.support_reason_id = sr.support_reason_id LEFT JOIN SUPPORT_ANSWER sa ON sa.answer_id = ( SELECT sa2.answer_id FROM SUPPORT_ANSWER sa2 WHERE sa2.support_id = s.support_id ORDER BY sa2.created_at DESC, sa2.answer_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN `USER` au ON sa.admin_user_id = au.user_id WHERE s.support_id = #{supportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SUPPORT SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE support_id = #{supportId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUPPORT_ANSWER (content, support_id, admin_user_id, created_at) VALUES ( #{content}, #{supportId}, #{adminUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SUPPORT_ANSWER WHERE support_id = #{supportId}
SELECT user_id FROM SUPPORT WHERE support_id = #{supportId}

SELECT b.bot_id AS botId, b.name AS name, b.display_name AS displayName, b.description AS description, b.selection_preview AS selectionPreview, b.avatar_image AS avatarImage, b.card_stats_json AS cardStatsJson, b.like_count AS likeCount, b.dislike_count AS dislikeCount, COALESCE(s.net, 0) AS prevMonthNet, COALESCE(s.reco, 0) AS prevMonthRecommendCount, COALESCE(s.disc, 0) AS prevMonthDislikeCount FROM BOT b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.bot_id AS bot_id, SUM(e.delta) AS net, SUM(CASE WHEN e.delta = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reco, SUM(CASE WHEN e.delta = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disc FROM BOT_RECOMMEND_EVENT e WHERE e.created_at >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AND e.created_at < DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) GROUP BY e.bot_id ) s ON s.bot_id = b.bot_id ORDER BY b.bot_id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT_RECOMMEND_EVENT e WHERE e.created_at >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AND e.created_at < DATE_ADD( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{year}, '-', LPAD(#{month}, 2, '0'), '-01 00:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT WHERE bot_id = #{botId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOT (name, display_name, avatar_image, description, selection_preview, card_stats_json, like_count, dislike_count, reset_at) VALUES ( #{name}, #{displayName}, #{avatarImage}, #{description}, #{selectionPreview}, #{cardStatsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, 0, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE BOT SET name = #{name}, display_name = #{displayName}, avatar_image = #{avatarImage}, description = #{description}, selection_preview = #{selectionPreview}, card_stats_json = #{cardStatsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE bot_id = #{botId}
